Wreath.html:
A classic round wreath for ornaments, suncatchers and gifts all year round.

Glass weight: tack fuse 85 to 100 g, full fuse 100 to 120 g
Prep: 3 to 4 coats of Zyp, especially where the inner post meets the base

Download your instruction sheet under Attached files. Print it and keep it by your kiln. It has your building tips and firing schedules.
